locator: Table IX, printed p. 206, Cuba, all classes; p. 93, oldest-age notation
published_scope: Entire reported Cuban census population, 1,572,797 people
definition: Reported age by sex, with single ages under five, split school and military ages, and unknown age.
opening_method: Transfer the 1899 census age-by-sex shares to Cuba's existing interpolated opening total using largest remainders. Keep the unknown-age share.
uncertainty: The census preceded opening by 77 days. The date shift, age heaping and census omissions have no estimated error interval.
